method: Research priority = rounded sum of factor weight × value/5 × evidence multiplier (V0 0, V1 .35, V2 .65, V3 .85, V4 1). Unknown earns zero. The next-test factor is an analyst judgment. This is not a probability, valuation, power score or spending authorization. Priority tier additionally requires current sourced polygon and all nine core county checks at full-polygon scope. Shared assemblage files are not independent opportunities. Prior rejections are strategy-specific and may be reopened with new evidence.

records.summary: First low-cost investigation: reconcile the legal offering and the road corridor before considering control. Acreage, public-road/easement status and usable contiguous area remain unresolved. The existing power and well signals are not service commitments.
records.thesis: A buyer-specific low-water industrial concept would need enough legally usable contiguous land after roads, easements, drainage and setbacks; an affordable transferable control agreement; a permitted-use path; and written utility intake. The working load hypothesis is not a buyer mandate.

sections.title: Land and buildable-area test
sections.body: Do not choose the largest acreage number or subtract an assumed road strip from marketing acreage. First establish the deed parcel and offered portion. A 50-foot corridor is only a reported width, and there is no confirmed corridor length. Gross acreage, net developable area and largest contiguous construction envelope are separate measurements. I-10 and rail adjacency can constrain access and construction; neither establishes a usable entrance or siding.

sections.title: County-first review performed and its limit
sections.body: The current planning page and official viewer were identified, along with the county parcel/tax GIS layer. Layer discovery is completed; a new exact-feature export and complete overlay intersection were not obtained. Preserve the earlier report values as inherited, not freshly verified. The 2026 comprehensive plan and data-center ordinance materials need a current, use-specific applicability review.

sections.title: Power, water and conflicting reports
sections.body: Prior reports differ on well retrieval and the substation relationship to the parcel. The file keeps the well and substation as leads, not proven on-site infrastructure. Obtain the original well record, survey/parcel overlay and exact utility territory response. No MW, well yield, fire-flow supply, rail service or utility schedule is established.
